nodes.label: Testnet implementation plan completed
nodes.description: All five plan tasks evidence-backed complete for testnet prototype: SDK/funding, tested model/store/recovery, guarded API, tested separate UI, and both live routes. Arc 1 USDC→0.822060 EURC and crosschain 1 USDC burn→1 USDC mint→0.822252 EURC paid/reconciled. Ten receipts independently verified; 54 tests, build, browser checks and reviews passed. Production and full fault coverage remain outside proven scope.

nodes.label: Testnet implementation ledger
nodes.description: Dated history preserves initial 36-test blocker, resolved Arc SDK/journal issues, CCTP indexing/attestation wait and five failing-then-passing message/sourceTxHash regressions. Final evidence: 54 tests pass, both routes reconciled and all ten receipts independently verified. Original CCTP burn survived restarts and approximately 24-minute attestation wait with no duplicate burn.

nodes.label: Just-in-time multicurrency treasury funding

nodes.label: Multicurrency tokenized-fund subscriptions

nodes.label: Confidential payroll watchlist

nodes.label: Bind attestation to original source transaction
nodes.description: Identical source burns can have identical immutable message bytes. Recovery requires Circle sourceTxHash to match the recorded original burn. Wrong-hash regression failed before fix; suite now passes 54/54.
nodes.norm_label: bind attestation to original source transaction
nodes.rationale: Immutable-byte comparison alone cannot distinguish otherwise identical burns; source transaction binding prevents accepting another burn's attestation.

nodes.label: Approval classification and restart recovery
nodes.description: Live USDC increaseAllowance was initially mislabeled swap:1. Exact receipt checks blocked false conversion. Added selector classification and journal intent matching, recovered legacy record as swap_approve:1 after restart with same hash and no rebroadcast. Already-converted state also survived restart.

nodes.label: Dedicated local test-only signer
nodes.description: Locally generated test wallet used by local Node server; production custody outside scope.
nodes.rationale: Provides runnable prototype without browser wallet setup; keys remain server-side.

nodes.label: Testnet acceptance requirements
nodes.description: Original acceptance requirements: validation, stage/persistence/replay/receipt/security tests, frontend build, browser flow, and precise real testnet hashes/outcomes when access permits. Simulation is not chain proof. Current acceptance evidence is maintained separately in PROJECT_MAP.

nodes.label: Historical StableFX settlement operations selection

nodes.rationale: Operational integration, exceptions and reconciled records were intended differentiators; score is not observed product-market fit.
